In detail

Le Piagge, a public-housing district on the city's northwestern edge, appears repeatedly in local crime coverage: a 2025 armed ambush/shooting linked to rival-gang tension (reported alongside a related shooting at the Isolotto as part of a wider 'gang war'), a stabbing incident, and an assault on a security guard. Brozzi itself is a more ordinary residential/industrial area with fewer specific incidents reported. Sources checked: La Nazione, 'La guerra tra bande. Spari all'Isolotto e agguato alle Piagge'; La Nazione, security guard assaulted at Le Piagge.
